items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: the big guys had snowed him under... somebody in Robbins, Robbins himself, wanted the doggone tune

ctx.x: Yeah, and the other guys came in there because at that time they were having a fight about tunes. You know, different guys -- you know, the big three, Robbins, so and so and so and so and so, you remember? The publishers?
